bugs_found: Testbench initially sampled writes before nonblocking assignments settled and reported 255 instead of 256; fixed by sampling after the NBA update.
Dynamic accum[drain_index] created a 256:1 result mux and severe timing/placement pressure; replaced with a shift-based drain.

The shift-based drain removed the output mux but introduced a very large register-to-register shift network, causing severe routing congestion even after enlarging the core from 40% to 25% utilization.
Verilator lint rejects nonblocking assignments to unpacked arrays inside procedural for loops although Icarus and Yosys accept the RTL.
Local ORFS installation lacked native tools and Docker access; P&R had to run on the Intel routing VM.
External SRAM interfaces mean the 96KiB SRAM macro area is excluded from the reported standard-cell area.
trials.learnings: The fresh outer-product RTL is functionally correct and meets a 200 MHz setup constraint through CTS, but storing 256 independent 24-bit accumulators and serializing them through either a dynamic mux or a full-register shift is physically poor. The next iteration should bank the accumulators and drain through a small mux tree, or write partial sums directly into SRAM/register-file macros. Area-only synthesis and pre-route timing are insufficient; routing topology is the dominant failure here.

A background retry disappeared at track assignment because the sandbox lifecycle terminated its Docker daemon; persistent tmux was required.
The GCS VM initially had an older ORFS image whose ODB schema revision 0.136 could not read the 0.139 checkpoint; pulling the current image fixed compatibility.
trials.learnings: Banking the 256 accumulators by output row fixes Y1's physical topology problem: global routing converged, detailed routing completed, and all DRC and antenna violations repaired to zero. The key improvement was localizing drain movement to one 16-word bank and reducing output selection to a fixed 16:1 mux. Y3 should preserve locality and eliminate selected-bank shifting entirely, for example with per-bank read pointers or a hierarchical non-shifting mux, while adding a post-route STA target and keeping the full flow on a persistent 16 GiB or larger routing host.

patterns.summary: Global 256-word shift/drain topology failed to converge in routing.
Final extracted max-capacitance violations invalidate otherwise clean flows.
Behavioral SRAM inference must be rejected at the external hard-macro boundary.
Accumulator widths require an executable signed-range proof.
Every registered SRAM response must have one consume event and one accumulation event.
Busy-start, k_dim latching, reset-abort, quiescence, and clean restart need locked regression evidence.
Require sufficient disk before launch and preserve infrastructure failure separately from design outcome.
A terminal marker must contain a parseable actual pipeline/container exit code; an empty marker is not evidence of success.
